---
title: "Titan 历史映射：覆盖与质量"
format: html
---

```{r}
source("r/quarto_helpers.R")
con <- connect_discovery()
```

## 覆盖摘要

```{r}
issues <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT issue_code) AS mapped_issues,
    COUNT(*) AS mapped_slots,
    COUNT(DISTINCT nowscore_provider_match_id) AS unique_titan_ids
  FROM issue_slot_nowscore_map
") |> tibble::as_tibble()
isolated <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT isolation_reason, COUNT(*) AS rows
  FROM conflict_isolated_slot
  GROUP BY isolation_reason
  ORDER BY rows DESC
") |> tibble::as_tibble()
issues
isolated
```

## 期次范围

```{r}
DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN length(issue_code) = 6 THEN '2010-2019（6位）' ELSE '2020+（5位）' END AS period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT issue_code) AS issues,
    COUNT(*) AS slots
  FROM issue_slot_nowscore_map
  GROUP BY period
") |> tibble::as_tibble()
```

## 人工跟进

```{r}
DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT issue_code, COUNT(*) AS attempts
  FROM mapping_failure
  GROUP BY issue_code
  ORDER BY issue_code
") |> tibble::as_tibble()
```

```{r}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```
